Chapter 438: Chapter 10: Interstellar Migration (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 438: Chapter 10: Interstellar Migration (Please Subscribe)_2

There was a faint crimson flame burning within.

The terrifying power almost spilled out, capable of easily burning Lin Yuan’s flesh, viscera, and bones, forcing the “Blood Rebirth” divine skill to be continuously activated. How could the might of that crimson flame be underestimated?

He did not know how much time had passed.

Suddenly, with a loud bang,

Lin Yuan’s physical body turned directly into ashes.

In an instant, amidst countless ashes, Lin Yuan’s body quickly reformed, returning anew.

...

“No wonder it’s necessary to have methods like ‘Blood Rebirth’ to open the gourd; without such techniques, daring to absorb the liquid inside the gourd would cost more lives than one has.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

Even with Blood Rebirth, Lin Yuan felt somewhat exhausted at this moment. Blood Rebirth could not be used indefinitely; each use consumed some of Lin Yuan’s power. Although it allowed for rapid recovery, frequent use was unsustainable.

“However…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

For the past half year, Lin Yuan had spent most of his time absorbing the crimson liquid inside the gourd, not knowing how many times he had been reborn through Blood Rebirth.

But the results were clearly visible.

Now, Lin Yuan’s inner world had reached a circumference of two million li.

That was three times its original size of seven hundred thousand li.

Normally, to expand the inner world to two million li in circumference, it was necessary to fully understand three thousand core space models.

This was a necessary prerequisite.

But now, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of core space models was only just over two thousand, corresponding to an inner world size that should be seven hundred thousand li.

“I wonder how big the teacher’s inner world is.”

Lin Yuan thought silently, the body of Chikun Star Lord being the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, whose inner world’s limit should exceed ten million li by a lot.

But that was the limit; even for Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, not many could reach the limit of their inner world.

Human Evolvers wanting to touch their limits needed to fully understand the complete space rules, and for Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, it wasn’t much easier.

“I’ll rest for a while.”

Lin Yuan stopped cultivating and planned to go out for a stroll.

Just then,

The voice of the Goddess of Wisdom suddenly rang out.

“Respected Galactic Star Lord, the current Milky Way Star Region has stabilized; shall we commence interstellar migration?”

“Interstellar migration?”

Lin Yuan was not surprised.

This star region, also known as the Milky Way Star Region, was originally taken from the Shadow Tribe by humans; it was naturally the territory of the Shadow Tribe and contained no human citizens.

Lin Yuan had come here early to familiarize himself with the environment and deal with some unstable elements.

To transform this star region entirely into a Human Civilization Territory, massive interstellar migration was necessary.

In the star region, with over one and a half million life planets, without a large number of human citizens residing permanently, these life planets were not very significant.

Those resource planets also needed many human citizens stationed there; many of these planets had frequent magnetic field fluctuations that could potentially cause malfunction in intelligent life.

They must be controlled by human citizens to ensure no major issues arise.

“Start it.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Milky Way Star Region was indeed lacking a large number of human citizens.

…

Chikun Star Domain.

On an ordinary middle-grade life planet,

a young man was saying goodbye to his parents.

“Son, how good it would be for us to live here peacefully; why must you migrate to such a distant star domain?”

The father looked helplessly at his younger son.

For ordinary citizens, one might never leave the star system in a lifetime, let alone the star domain. The son volunteering to migrate to a fringe starfield meant that it was very likely they would never see each other again.

Ordinary citizens did not have access to virtual world privileges.

“Dad, Mom, the universe is so vast, I don’t want to be trapped on a planet all my life.”

“This time, the star domain I am migrating to is overseen by our Shisan Peak Master, the Milky Way Star Region.”

“As one of the first migrants, I will definitely get more opportunities, and maybe I can become an Evolver.”

“Then, I will definitely come back to see you.”

The young man was spirited, not noticing the sorrow in his parents’ eyes.

“Let it be; the son has grown up. Since he has his own ideas, let’s go along with it,” the mother sighed nearby.

“When you get there, make sure to give us a video call.”

The mother patted the young boy’s head and cautioned.

“Got it, got it.”

“The migration battleship is almost here.”

“I have to go now. Take good care of yourselves.”

The young boy glanced at the time and immediately turned and strode away.

The two parents watched for a long time and only withdrew their gazes when the boy had completely disappeared.

The territory of the Human Civilization Alliance was expanding at every moment, so migration was a common occurrence.

Migrating to a newly opened star domain had its disadvantages and its advantages.

The disadvantage lied in the living environment or even the planetary environment, which was definitely not as stable and safe as in the more established star domains.

Some newly opened star domains might also face threats from indigenous populations.

But the advantages were also clear.

That was the completely open channel for ascension.

In those mature and stable rear star domains, human citizens could live well even without working, thanks to ample social welfare.

But the social classes were essentially ossified, unless one became an Evolver or a high-ranking citizen, it was hard to move across classes.

But was it that easy to become an Evolver?

Not to mention a high-ranking citizen.

But in these newly opened star domains, such goals were relatively easier to achieve.

The various paths for becoming an Evolver and the merit points needed for citizen rank promotion were opened up to a degree to encourage migrants in the new star domains.

Although not much, there was at least a way to obtain them.

Thus, many human citizens who were dissatisfied with their current status and had lofty ideals did not object to migration.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan briefly reviewed the migration situation.

“Many citizens from the Chikun Star Domain have come over?”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

In the Milky Way Star Region, Shisan Peak Master’s territory, if one were to choose to migrate, better to come to the Milky Way Star Region rather than moving to an unknown star domain.

Not to mention getting the care of Shisan Peak Master, at least one wouldn’t suffer from inferior treatment.

“Human civilization spans the universe, based upon its vast population.”

Lin Yuan thought silently in his heart.

Like the Insect Race, one of the Peak Clans, the true members of the Insect Race were rare, and the vast majority of them were Insect Race Warriors produced by the Insect Race Hive.

In various battlefields between humans and the Insect Race, many involved one Insect Race Hive battling against countless human Evolvers.

The most terrifying aspect of the Insect Race Hive was its ability to continuously produce Insect Race Warriors, and although it consumed huge amounts of energy, there were hardly any apparent limitations.

Even so.

In the war between humans and the Insect Race, even if one ignored the influence of the top-tier combat power of the Supreme Beings, humans were only pressured by the Insect Race, far from being defeated.

What was it that they relied on?

It was the large number of human Evolvers.

And where did these numerous human Evolvers come from?

It was from an even larger population base.

…

No. B520 Alien Battlefield.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit, disguised as a typical human Eighth Layer Evolver, entered the human-controlled area of the battlefield.

In a medium-sized otherworldly battlefield, Eighth Layer powerhouses were quite common, ranging from early stage to mid-stage to late stage, and even peak stage of the Eighth Layer had significant differences.

Not to mention those nearly transcending the Eighth Layer known as the Invincible of the Eighth Layer.

An Eighth Layer Invincible could generally dominate in a medium-sized otherworldly battlefield, and even if they had bad luck and ran into a Ninth Rank powerhouse, they still had a chance to survive.

“This battlefield’s Eternal Spatial Rift spans ten thousand meters, caused by the aftermath of a Supreme Being’s actions one hundred fifty thousand years ago…”

Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit eagerly anticipated as he followed the human Evolvers towards the Eternal Spatial Rift.

Very soon.

Lin Yuan saw that terrifyingly fluctuating Eternal Spatial Rift.

“Let’s see how much this boosts the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force.”

Lin Yuan immediately dove into his inner world mentally, keenly sensing that majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms.

The spatial rifts in the previously encountered small-sized otherworldly battlefields ranged in size from ten meters to several tens of meters.

A moment later.

Lin Yuan’s eyes snapped open, a look of joy surfacing on his face.
